overview_description.description: Bueno Finance is a fintech platform that provides blue-collar workers with short-term credit. To support its accelerated growth plans, the company will expand its product offerings and strengthen its team across engineering, product, sales, credit, and operations. It also provides a UPI handle backed by a credit line approved by Bueno Finance; this can be used to make purchases at any online merchant. Customers can also use the app to transact in the offline world by scanning QR codes found at every merchant.
